brand.name: CWorks
brand.tagline: We design, build, and ship digital products for Ugandan businesses.

process.title: Discovery Call
process.body: We sit down with you, in person or virtually, to understand what you need. We talk through your goals, your audience, any sites you like the look of, and your budget. This gives us everything we need to put together a solid proposal.

process.title: Proposal & Agreement
process.body: We send you a clear breakdown of scope, cost, and timeline. Once you're happy, we agree on payment terms and get the project officially started. No hidden fees, no surprises.

process.title: Design
process.body: We build out the visual direction of your site (layout, colours, fonts, and structure). You review and give feedback, and we refine until you sign off. Nothing moves to code until the design is approved.

process.title: Build
process.body: With the design locked in, we build. We share progress along the way and give you a preview link before the final review so you can see exactly how it looks and feels.

process.title: Review & Revisions
process.body: You go through the built product and tell us what you'd like adjusted. We work through the agreed revision rounds until everything is exactly as it should be.

process.title: Launch & Handover
process.body: We deploy, set up the domain, and make sure everything is live and working. You get the full source code, a walkthrough, and a support window to handle anything post-launch.

services.name: Website Building
services.short: End-to-end web development — from a blank page to a live, polished site.

included.b: We start with your goals, brand, and inspiration. From there we put together a visual layout (colours, typography, and structure) and share it with you for feedback before a single line of code is written.
Your site is built in modern, standards-based code — no bloat. Every site is built mobile-first, tested across browsers, and optimised for fast load times.
You provide your text and images, and we place and format everything to look its best. We'll tell you exactly what we need and in what format before we start.
We handle the full deployment, from setting up your hosting environment to connecting your domain.
Once live, you receive the full source code. We walk you through how everything works and stay available for a post-launch support window.

pricing.desc: Perfect for individuals and small projects that need a clean, professional online presence without the complexity.
For businesses and creators who need a fully custom, multi-page site with proper hosting and a real domain.
For complex projects that demand advanced functionality, backend capability, and a fully configured server environment.

Organised files, specs, and assets your developers can build from.

services.name: Graphic Design
services.short: Visuals that communicate who you are before you say a word.

included.b: Logo, colour palette, and typography that work together as a system.
Templates and ready-to-post graphics for your channels.
Flyers, posters, business cards, and banners — print-ready.
A style guide so your brand stays consistent everywhere.
All vector and export files handed over, clearly organised.

pricing.desc: Best for individuals or small projects needing a single deliverable — a logo, a flyer, or a set of social templates.
For businesses that need a cohesive visual identity — logo, colour palette, typography, and supporting assets.

services.name: Database Management
services.short: Databases that store data reliably, retrieve it fast, and scale as you grow.

included.b: Tables, relationships, and indexes designed for how you actually query.
Visual documentation of your data model.
Moving from spreadsheets or a legacy database without losing data.
Role-based permissions so the right people see the right data.
Automated backup configuration and recovery planning.

pricing.desc: For small projects or single-purpose applications that need a clean, well-structured database to get started on.
For business applications that need a robust, multi-table database with data migration and query optimisation.
features: Data migration from spreadsheets or legacy DB

pricing.desc: For large or complex systems with many tables, high-volume data, stored procedures, or ongoing DBA support.

services.name: System Building
services.short: Custom systems tailored exactly to how your business operates.

included.b: We map what you do today manually and turn it into system logic.
A MySQL database designed for your data.
Web-based software that runs in the browser, on any device.
Dashboards and exportable reports for the numbers that matter.
We train your staff and hand over documentation.

pricing.desc: For small businesses that need a single-module system — a basic inventory tracker, a simple booking form, or a staff records tool.
For businesses that need a multi-module system — inventory plus sales, bookings plus staff records, or a full POS with reporting.
features: Up to 4 user roles with permissions

pricing.desc: For large organisations or complex requirements — multi-branch systems, API integrations, high user volumes, or systems that scale across departments.

faq.q: How long does a project take?
faq.a: Starter sites take around 1 week, Standard sites 2–3 weeks, and larger systems are scoped per project. Content readiness and revision rounds affect delivery.

faq.q: Do I need to provide the content?
faq.a: Yes — you provide your text, images, and branding. We advise on structure and sourcing, and copywriting is available as a paid add-on.

faq.q: Can you update or rebuild my existing site?
faq.a: Yes. Share your current site and what you'd like changed, and we'll assess and quote from there.

faq.q: What do I need to get started?
faq.a: Just a rough idea of what you want, a few sites you like the look of, and your budget. We handle the rest from the discovery call onwards.
Yes. Post-launch support is available for updates, fixes, and small changes — either case-by-case or as a monthly retainer.
